metadata.treeSnapshot: User project snapshot, 8 April 2026; individual survey dates unknown
metadata.method: Approximate canopy overlap over a 10 m wide road corridor, sampled at <=1 m longitudinal spacing and 1 m transverse spacing. TreeCanopyNS / 2 gives circular radius. Missing diameters default to 4 m, matching original project. No time-of-day, temperature, shadows or building shade.
metadata.coverageWarning: City asset register contains park and street trees only; campus and private trees may be absent. Zero means no mapped overlap, not proof of no shade.
